# Studio Click House Limited (SCHL)

> Studio Click House Limited (SCHL) is a visual post-production studio based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with offices in Stockholm, Sydney, and London. SCHL provides image editing, photo retouching, video post-production, and photorealistic 3D CGI for e-commerce brands, retailers, agencies, photographers, and studios.

## Production facts

- Standard image turnaround is typically 12–24 hours when the brief and volume allow; rush delivery is agreed per project.
- Accepted source files include RAW files such as CR2, NEF, ARW, and DNG, plus PSD, PSB, TIFF, JPEG, and PNG where appropriate.
- The studio supports individual jobs and high-volume catalog batches, with published examples of 2,000+ image edits per day and 3,000+ garments processed weekly.
- Each delivery passes artist review and senior quality control for edges, retouching, color, naming, and export settings.
- Clients can request a free trial edit using sample images before starting a full batch.
- Start a project through info@studioclickhouse.com, WhatsApp, or the contact page.
